visa.apply: Fill the arrival card up to 72 hours before landing
visa.summary: Indian passport holders can enter Thailand for tourism without a visa. From 15 September 2026 the visa-free stay is 30 days, down from 60.
before: Check your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the day you land
Complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival
Save your return ticket, hotel bookings and itinerary on your phone
Carry cash for immigration checks: the Indian embassy advisory mentions THB 20,000 per person
docs: Hotel confirmations and a day-by-day itinerary
notes: Visitors arriving on or after 15 September 2026 get up to 30 days. Anyone who entered earlier keeps the stay stamped at entry.
The immigration officer at the airport makes the final decision on entry, so keep your documents handy.
For more than 30 days you need a visa (Thailand's e-visa portal) or an extension at a local immigration office. Our packages fit comfortably inside 30 days.

visa.cost: IDR 500,000 (about ₹2,800) plus Bali tourist levy IDR 150,000
visa.processing: e-VOA usually 1–3 working days; counter VOA on the spot
visa.apply: e-VOA 1–2 weeks before travel, or pay at Bali airport
visa.form: All Indonesia arrival card (free, within 3 days before arrival)
visa.summary: Indian tourists get a visa on arrival at Bali airport. Applying for the e-VOA online first lets you skip the payment queue.
before: Apply for the e-VOA on the official Indonesian immigration portal, or plan to pay at the airport counter
Pay the Bali tourist levy online before you fly, or on arrival
Complete the Indonesia arrival card within 3 days before landing
Save the e-VOA and levy QR codes to your phone and keep a printout
Check your passport is valid for at least 6 months
docs: Passport bio page scan and a recent photo (for e-VOA)
Debit or credit card for the visa fee and levy
notes: The airport VOA queue can take 30 to 90 minutes in peak season. That is the main reason to apply for the e-VOA in advance.
Use the government portal only. Look-alike sites charge extra for the same service.
Rupee amounts move with the exchange rate, so treat them as a guide.

visa.stay: 30 or 60 days, single or multiple entry
visa.cost: About ₹7,500–₹9,500 for 30 days, ₹14,700–₹18,000 for 60 days, service fees included (indicative)
visa.summary: Most Indian tourists need a UAE visa arranged before flying. Visa on arrival exists only for Indians holding a valid visa or residence permit from countries such as the US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, Japan, New Zealand, South Korea or Singapore, for up to 14 days.
before: Send us your passport scan, a photo and your travel dates
We arrange the visa through an authorised UAE partner
Confirmed hotel booking and return flight are needed for the application
When the visa arrives, check that the name and passport number match exactly
docs: Passport valid for 6+ months from arrival
Passport-size photo on a white background
Confirmed hotel booking in the UAE
notes: Indian travellers cannot apply directly on a government website or at a consulate for a tourist visa. It goes through UAE airlines or authorised agents.
The visa is generally applied for no more than about 30 days before travel.
Visa fees are not refunded if an application is rejected.

visa.cost: SGD 30 government fee plus agent charges (about ₹3,100 or more in total)
visa.form: SG Arrival Card (free, within 3 days before arrival)
visa.summary: India is on Singapore's visa-required list. The visa is applied for through an authorised agent or the ICA e-Service, and the SG Arrival Card is a separate free form.
before: Send us your passport, photo and travel dates so we can apply through an authorised channel
Wait for the approved visa, then keep a copy on your phone
Submit the SG Arrival Card for every traveller, including children, within 3 days before arrival
Check your passport is valid for at least 6 months
docs: Proof of address if it differs from your passport
notes: There is no visa on arrival for Indian passport holders in Singapore.
Airlines flying from India can refuse boarding if the SG Arrival Card is missing.
A visa does not guarantee entry: immigration officers make the final decision.

visa.apply: Fill the arrival card within 3 days before arrival
visa.summary: Malaysia lets Indian citizens in for up to 30 days without a visa for tourism, currently announced until 31 December 2026.
before: Submit the MDAC online within 3 days before arrival, one for each traveller including children
Check your passport is valid for at least 6 months and has a blank page
Keep your return ticket and hotel bookings ready to show
Carry proof of funds in case immigration asks
notes: The waiver is announced through 31 December 2026 by the Malaysian government. For travel after that date we re-check before you book.
Some travellers have been turned back for an incomplete arrival card, no return ticket or unclear funds.
The waiver covers tourism and social visits, not work or study.

visa.processing: Granted at the immigration counter in Malé
visa.apply: Nothing in advance, but submit the traveller declaration first
visa.form: Maldives Traveller Declaration, IMUGA (free, within 96 hours before arrival)
visa.summary: Every visitor, including Indians, gets a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival at Malé. You need a confirmed booking and an onward ticket.
before: Submit the online traveller declaration within 96 hours before your flight
Keep your confirmed resort or hotel booking for the whole stay ready to show
Carry your return ticket, printed and on your phone
Check your passport is valid for at least 6 months
docs: Confirmed accommodation for the full stay
Proof of funds, such as a credit card or prepaid resort booking
notes: Immigration can ask for proof of funds and accommodation, so a consolidated resort voucher helps.
The declaration process has changed before. We confirm the current form when we issue your travel documents.

visa.stay: Up to 90 days in any 180 days, across the Schengen area
visa.cost: €90 adult, €45 ages 6–11, free under 6, plus VFS service fee (about ₹1,850–₹2,150)
visa.processing: About 15 working days; up to 45 days in peak season
visa.apply: Several weeks ahead; book the VFS appointment early
visa.form: None (biometric registration at the border under the EES)
visa.summary: Switzerland needs a Schengen short-stay visa, applied for in person with fingerprints and a photo. Start well ahead, because appointments and peak-season processing can take weeks.
before: Send us your dates and we'll draft a day-by-day itinerary and bookings for the file
Buy Schengen travel insurance with at least €30,000 medical cover
Gather bank statements, income tax returns and employment or business proof
Book the VFS appointment and attend in person for biometrics
Track the application and collect your passport
docs: Passport valid well beyond your return date, with blank pages
Two photos, 35 × 45 mm, white or light grey background
Flight and hotel bookings, plus day-by-day itinerary
Bank statements, ITRs and employer or business documents
notes: Apply at the Swiss representation if Switzerland is your main destination, or where you spend the most nights.
Switzerland typically expects proof of roughly CHF 100 per day of stay.
ETIAS does not apply to Indian citizens. You need the full visa. The Entry/Exit System now records biometrics at the border in place of passport stamps.

visa.stay: Up to 90 days, based on the validity you choose
visa.cost: USD 25 single entry, USD 50 multiple entry
visa.summary: Indian passport holders need a visa for Vietnam. The e-Visa is the simplest route and is applied for online.
before: Check your passport is valid for at least 6 months, with 2 blank pages
Apply on the official Vietnam e-Visa portal, or send us the details and we'll do it with you
Print the approved e-Visa and keep a copy on your phone
Make a separate application for each traveller, including infants
docs: Travel dates and first address in Vietnam
notes: Only apply on the official portal. Look-alike sites charge extra fees.
Airlines can refuse boarding without a valid visa, so print or save it before you leave.
The e-Visa is for tourism. It is separate from visa on arrival, which needs an approval letter from an agency.

visa.stay: Short-term tourist stay, as printed on the visa
visa.cost: ₹500 government fee plus VFS service charge (about ₹2,100 in total)
visa.apply: Book a VFS Japan appointment early
visa.summary: Indian passport holders need a visa for Japan. There is no visa on arrival and no visa-free entry. Applications go through VFS Global.
before: Prepare a day-by-day schedule of stay with hotel names
Collect bank statements and income proof
Book a VFS Japan appointment and submit your documents
If your visa is issued digitally, save the issuance notice on your phone
docs: Bank statements and income tax or employment proof
notes: From 1 July 2026 the Embassy of Japan lists the fee for Indian nationals at ₹500, for single or multiple entry. The transit visa has been abolished.
VFS service charges are added, and appointment availability varies by city.
Rules and processing times change, so we confirm with the Embassy or VFS before you submit.
